').findIndex((l) => l.includes('call the printer')); ed.setCursor({ line: n, ch: 6 }); await app.commands.executeCommandById('shortcuts-bridge:fav-tidy-task'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const u = new URL(window.__opened[0]); if (u.searchParams.get('text') !== '- [ ] call the printer about the flyers') throw new Error('wrong input ' + u.searchParams.get('text')); const id = new URL(u.searchParams.get('x-success')).searchParams.get('id'); await app.workspace.protocolHandler.handlers.get('shortcuts-bridge')({ action: 'shortcuts-bridge', vault: app.vault.getName(), id, status: 'success', result: '- [ ] Call the printer about the flyers by Thursday' }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const after = ed.getValue(); const want = before.replace('- [ ] call the printer about the flyers', '- [ ] Call the printer about the flyers by Thursday'); if (after !== want) throw new Error('replace failed: ' + JSON.stringify(after)); ed.undo(); if (ed.getValue() !== before) throw new Error('undo failed: ' + JSON.stringify(ed.getValue())); ed.redo(); if (ed.getValue() !== want) throw new Error('redo failed'); ed.setCursor({ line: n, ch: 0 }); return 'ok'; })()
